diagnosis: The multi-tenant billing route extracts tenantId from OpenTelemetry baggage headers rather than validated JWT claims. Because HTTP baggage headers can be spoofed by any client, an authenticated user from Tenant A can supply a baggage header specifying tenant.id=tenant_target to read billing records, payment histories, and invoices of Tenant B.
exploit_request:
GET /api/billing/invoices HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saas-platform.com
Authorization: Bearer valid_jwt_for_tenant_10
baggage: tenant.id=tenant_fortune500_enterprise
